messages:
anna: Quick sync — I'm wrapping up the relnotes for the docs site push tomorrow (0.9.5). Need a few callouts: streaming embeddings Preview, adaptive routing opt-in, and a small Windows conda path known issue for Private. Who can own the SDK snippet fixes?

rahul: I can do JS snippets. Which endpoints changed?

anna: Short list: embeddings streaming parameter `stream=true` now supported, and JS SDK now returns an AsyncIterable. Need example like:```js
const stream = client.embeddings.stream({model: 'embed-v1', input: 'hello'})
for await (const chunk of stream) console.log(chunk)
```

rahul: Nice. I'll add an AsyncIterator example and also mention node 18+. Will submit PR to docs/snippets/js tomorrow morning. @sophie can you handle python?

sophie: Yep. For Python it's still generator-based:```py
for chunk in client.embeddings.stream('hello', model='embed-v1'):
    print(chunk)
```Also noting that in virtualenv on Windows you may need: `set CONDA_DLL_SEARCH_MODIFICATION_ENABLE=1` — add to known-issues.

lee: I'm updating the changelog bullets. Suggest small-prints: 'Streaming embeddings are in Preview; latency may vary; use batch_fallback for throughput' — ok?

sam: Also need to call out migration: `model=embed-v1` -> `embed-v1.1` compatibility note and auto-fallback behavior. I'll add a short A/B test note for Dedicated customers.

anna: Great. Two procedural items: (1) run link-checker after PRs — docs-ci-bot will run but manual sweep recommended; (2) add a 'Known issue' anchor so we can link from release email.

docs-ci-bot: link-checker: all links pass in current branch except docs/private/windows.md#conda — broken anchor.

sophie: I'll fix the anchor and add the conda step. Pushing patch in 10m.

rahul: PR #2345 opened: js snippet async iterator + node version note. @anna can you review copy for the relnotes paragraph?

anna: Reviewing now. Quick wording tweak: change 'Preview' -> 'Early preview' where appropriate for marketing alignment. otherwise lgtm.

lee: :thumbsup: I'll merge changelog PR after docs-ci green. ETA EOD.

sam: Any migration guide snippet for private deploys (on-prem) about KMS rotation? I can draft a short blurb.

anna: Please do, Sam. Put it under 'operational notes' with steps and a link to the KMS guide. We're all set.
